references.text: The burnt offering shall be a bull or a lamb without defect, as described in the consecration offering here
A calf and a lamb, both one year old and without defect, were to be offered as a burnt offering
A one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering is also mentioned in connection with the purification offering
The identical wording is used for Nahshon's offering, showing the standardized form of the tribal leaders' offerings
The same offering from Netanel son of Zuar shows the repetition of this pattern
Eliab son of Helon gave the same burnt offering of a bull, a ram and a one-year-old lamb
Monthly burnt offerings also included bulls, rams and one-year-old lambs
At the new moon festival, a burnt offering of a bull, a ram and one-year-old lambs was to be offered
